snippet.title: Flower Shop | Trailer (New Horror Game 2022)
snippet.description:
It is a hermetic horror that pretends to be your friend. The game begins at a flower shop. At first, it looks like a naive florist simulator. Gradually, the game pulls you into the abyss of madness.

You can add a game to your Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1784860/Flower_Shop/
